cells.gaps: No text of the Politique nationale de développement des TIC has been found, linked or quoted from an official site, and no source gives its adoption act or date, its period, a delivery plan, a report against its targets, a mandated body or a budget line. cells.note: Politique nationale de développement des TIC: the minister reported progress under it in July 2025, so it is read as adopted and in force, as Comoros's policy is on its minister's statement; the SSI 2014-2024 before it has ended.
